Lockheed Martin and Pentagon agree on F-35 fighter jet deal

Lockheed Martin and the U.S. Defense Department have reached a 10-year agreement for at least 850 F-35 fighter jets. The deal specifies the terms for the production and delivery of these aircraft over the next decade.
